notes: Proved for the entry's own sequence (g(n) = n^3, f = 1/k): |M(n) - ((n-1/2)^3 + 1/2)| < 1/8 for n >= 3 (midpoint-rule bounds on H_B - H_A, artanh series, sympy sign analysis for n >= 12, interval arithmetic below), so a(n) = ((2n-1)^3+4) div 8 for n >= 3 and the entry's order-7 recurrence holds for n >= 10. The general Kimberling conjecture (all f = u/(vk+w), polynomial g) is not settled. Outside Lean: everything.
